rationale: Both documents credit Raman et al. 2026's white-bear stance as the prior method the task is measured against, report the same 0.83 vs. ~0.18 numbers, and frame the delivered method as a genuinely distinct task-contrast vector (closest to a zero-shot function vector) rather than a reproduction of the white-bear stance, a disposition vector, or a readout correction. The message adds a slightly more precise filename and one extra swept contrast ('label-vs-continue') not listed in the write-up, while omitting the write-up's explicit naming of Herrera et al. when explaining what the method is not; these are minor, non-material differences in detail rather than differences in the core sourcing or novelty claims, which are equal.
